hero.title: Your path to Spain starts here.
hero.subtitle: Elite Education is an educational agency dedicated to the Spanish language, education and international experiences in Spain. We help students and families take their next step — from learning Spanish and preparing for international exams, to choosing a university and organising educational programmes in Spain.

about.label: About us
about.title: You have a goal. We know the path.
about.body1: Elite Education was born from a personal need for what is often missing when you first step into international education: clear information, someone who understands the process, and support that does not stop at the paperwork.
about.body2: Our focus is Spain — its language, education and the experience of living there. We want to make a process that might seem complicated feel simpler, more personal and better organised.
about.mission_text: To connect people with the right educational opportunities in Spain and provide them with the kind of support we ourselves would have loved to have had at the start of our own journey.

founder.label: About the founder
founder.name: Nevena Mušatović
founder.bio1: My relationship with Spain began through the Spanish language and grew over time into education, travel and international programmes. During my studies I had the opportunity to spend time in Madrid through cultural exchanges, and to take part in various international programmes and projects.
founder.bio2: Those experiences showed me how much a stay abroad can change the way you look at education, career and your own possibilities. But they also showed me how difficult things are when information is scattered and you have to figure out a large part of the process on your own.
founder.bio3: That is why I wanted to create Elite Education — not as another agency that simply forwards applications, but as a place where a student can get clear advice, a realistic picture of their options and support throughout the entire process.
founder.bio4: Today, through Elite Education, I bring together my experience in Spanish language, international education and working in international environments, with the goal of making easier the journey I once walked myself.
founder.image_alt: Nevena Mušatović, founder of Elite Education

services.label: Services
services.title: Everything you need for your path to Spain.
services.subtitle: Whether you are just exploring possibilities or already know what you want, Elite Education provides support at every stage of your educational journey.
services.s01_body: Language learning is the beginning of every international experience. We organise lessons tailored to your level, goals and pace — whether you are learning Spanish out of love for the language, for travel, education or professional development.
s01_bullets: Spanish for studying and living in Spain
services.s01_tagline: Learning a language is the beginning of every international experience.
services.s02_body: Choosing a university and navigating the application process in another country can seem complicated. Our goal is to turn it into a clear, organised process. We help students find a programme that matches their interests, academic goals and possibilities.
s02_bullets: Choosing a university and study programme
services.s02_tagline: We are not just looking for a university. We are looking for what is right for you.
services.s03_title: A first international experience worth remembering.
services.s03_body: Language camps give young people the chance to learn Spanish, meet peers from different countries and experience life in an international environment. We help parents and students find a programme that suits the child's age, interests and wishes.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Answers to the most common questions
faq.subtitle: Short answers to the questions we hear most often. Each answer links to the full guide article.
faq.q1_question: What is UNEDasiss and who needs it?
faq.q1_answer: UNEDasiss is a system of the Spanish distance university that provides international applicants with services related to university admission. Whether you need it depends on your country of origin and the specific university you are applying to.
faq.q2_question: DELE or SIELE — which exam should I choose?
faq.q2_answer: DELE is a permanent diploma from Instituto Cervantes with no expiry date. SIELE is a digital, multi-level system that gives a result on a scale of 1,000 points and is valid for five years. The choice depends on your specific purpose.
faq.q3_question: How much do studies and student life in Spain cost?
faq.q3_answer: National average tuition is around €15.37 per ECTS credit at public universities. Monthly living costs vary from around €800–950 in Barcelona to €1,300–1,500 in Madrid depending on lifestyle and accommodation.
faq.q4_question: How do I assess my Spanish level?
faq.q4_answer: Level assessment should cover at least reading comprehension, listening, grammar and vocabulary, writing, and spoken expression. A level is a starting point for a plan — not a label.
faq.q5_question: Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia or Málaga — which city is right for me?
faq.q5_answer: There is no single best city for every student. It depends on your budget, your studies, your lifestyle and your priorities. Each city has a different pace, atmosphere and academic scene.
